entries.en_definition: Study of how resources are allocated to meet needs and wants.
entries.to_definition: Ako ki hono leva'i e ngaahi naunau'/koloa' ke feau e ngaahi fiemaú vivili' mo e fakananivi'.

entries.en_definition: The limited nature of resources.
entries.to_definition: Natula fe'āmokaki ó e ngaahi naunau', fakatatau ki he fiemaú'.

entries.en_definition: The next best alternative foregone when making a choice.
entries.to_definition: Toenga fili hoko hake ki hoó fili úluaki ne fakahoko'.

entries.en_definition: The quantity of a good that producers are willing to sell at different prices.
entries.to_definition: Lahi e koloa fakatau atu ;óku loto pea malava é he taha fatukoloa'ó fakatau atu í he mahu'ínga takitaha.

entries.en_definition: Quantity supplied is greater than quantity demanded at a given price, leading to a surplus and downward price pressure.
entries.to_definition: Lahi ange ai e koloa óku fakatau atu', he koloa óku fiemaú 'í he maketi', í he mahu'ínga/totongi takitaha.

entries.en_definition: The quantity of a good consumers are willing to buy at different prices.
entries.to_definition: Lahi e koloa fakatau mai ;óku loto pea malava é he taha fiemaú koloa' ó  fakatau mai í he mahu'ínga takitaha.

entries.en_definition: Quantity demanded is greater than quantity supplied at a given price, leading to a shortage and upward price pressure.
entries.to_definition: Lahi ange ai e koloa óku fiemaú', he koloa óku tukumai 'í he maketi', í he mahuínga/totongi takitaha.

entries.en_definition: The price at which quantity supplied equals quantity demanded.
entries.to_definition: Lahi tatau e koloa óku fiemaú', mo e koloa óku tukumai 'í he maketi', í he mahuínga/totongi takitaha.

entries.en_definition: A place where buyers and sellers interact.
entries.to_definition: Fetaulakiánga ia ó e taha fiemaú'/fakatau' mo e taha tuúaki'.

entries.en_definition: The responsiveness of demand or supply to changes in price.
entries.to_definition: Lahi e liliu e fiemaú koloa ke fakatau atu'' mo e koloa fakatau mai'', tupu mei he feliuliuaki e mahuínga'/totongi'.

entries.en_definition: A measure of how quantity demanded changes with price.
entries.to_definition: Lahi e liliu e fiemaú koloa ke fakatau atu', tupu mei he feliuliuaki e mahuínga'/totongi'.

entries.en_definition: A measure of how quantity demanded changes with price.
entries.to_definition: Lahi e liliu e fiemaú koloa ke fakatau mai', tupu mei he feliuliuaki e mahuínga'/totongi'.

entries.en_definition: Change in demand based on income change.
entries.to_definition: Lahi e liliu e fiemaú koloa ke fakatau mai', tupu mei he feliuliuaki e tuúnga vāhenga.

entries.en_definition: Goods that can replace each other.
entries.to_definition: Koloa natula tatau.

entries.en_definition: Goods used together.
entries.to_definition: Koloa ke ngaueáki fakataha.

entries.to_term: Taungatonu ki he taha ngaueáki e koloa.
entries.en_definition: The difference between what consumers are willing to pay and what they actually pay.
entries.to_definition: Faikehekehe ó e mahuínga ó ha koloa fakataumai ki he tokotaha fiemaú' pea mo e fakamole naá ne totongi ki he koloa ko ia'.

entries.to_term: Taungatonu ki he taha fakatupu koloa
entries.en_definition: The difference between the price received and the minimum acceptable price.
entries.to_definition: Faikehekehe ó e mahuínga maúlalo taha ó ha koloa fakatau atu ki he tokotaha fatukoloa' pea mo e mahuínga fefakatauáki í he maketi'.

entries.en_definition: When the market does not allocate resources efficiently.
entries.to_definition: Taimi óku tonounou ai e maketi' hono tuhani fakalelei e e ngaahi naunau'/koloa'.

entries.en_definition: Goods that are non-rival and non-excludable (e.g., streetlights).
entries.to_definition: Koloa é íkai holoa hono lahi' mo hono natula', neongo e tokolahi hono ngaueáki' pea ;ikai kene fakangatangata ha taha mei hono ngaueáki'.

entries.en_definition: Side effects of economic activity on third parties (can be positive or negative).
entries.to_definition: Ko hono olamelie/olatamaki ó ha ngaue fakaékonomika ki ha taha ne íkai kaungatonu ki he ngaue ko ia'.

entries.en_definition: The act of consuming goods or services that have a beneficial impact, either on the individual, society, or the environment.
entries.to_definition: Maú/ Kai pe fakaáongaí ó ha koloa', é he taha, pea ínasi ai ha tahakehe, sosaieti pe átakai í hono ola melie'.

entries.en_definition: The act of producing goods or services that create a beneficial impact, either economically, socially, or environmentally
entries.to_definition: Fokotuú, fatu pe ngaohi koloa ha taha, pea ínasi ai ha tahakehe, sosaieti pe átakai í hono ola melie'.

entries.en_definition: When one person's consumption harms others (e.g., secondhand smoke).
entries.to_definition: Maú/ Kai pe fakaáongaí ó ha koloa',é he taha, pea uesia/kavahia ai ha tahakehe, sosaieti pe átakai í hono olatamaki'.

entries.en_definition: When a firm's production harms others not compensated
entries.to_definition: Fokotuú, fatu pe ngaohi  koloa ha taha, pea uesia/kavahia ai ha tahakehe, sosaieti pe átakai í hono olatamaki'.

entries.en_definition: Total value of goods and services produced in a country.
entries.to_definition: Mahuínga ó e koloa fakalotofonua ne ngaohi/fakatupu í he taú.

entries.en_definition: A general rise in prices over time.
entries.to_definition: Hikihiki á e totongi fakalukufua e koloa. í ha vaha'a taimi.

entries.en_definition: Extremely rapid and out-of-control inflation, where prices increase at an exceptionally high rate
Inflation caused by an increase in aggregate demand (total spending) in the economy, outstripping the economy's ability to produce goods and services. "Too much money chasing too few goods."
entries.to_definition: Tōólunga e totongi' makatuúnga hono fiemaúa e koloa'.

entries.en_definition: Inflation caused by an increase in the costs of production (like raw materials, labor, or energy), which forces businesses to raise their prices to maintain profit margins.
entries.to_definition: Tōólunga e totongi', makatuúnga he fakamole ki hono faú e koloa'.

entries.to_term: Hiki māmālie e totongi e koloa
entries.en_definition: Slowing down of the inflation rate; prices still rise, but slower.
entries.to_definition: Kei hikihiki pe totongi fakalukufua ó e koloa í ha vahaá taimi, ka óku kií māmālie , tuma, nga'i, íkai makimo.

entries.en_definition: A general fall in prices over time.
entries.to_definition: Hṓloa  á e totongi fakalukufua ó e koloa í ha vahaá taimi.

entries.en_definition: An economy characterized by high inflation, low economic growth and high unemployment
entries.to_definition: Taimi eni óku tōólunga e totongi koloa', hoaniáki e tōlalo ai á e tupu fakaékonōmika', pea kanoniáki é tōólunga á e taémaúngāue'.

entries.en_definition: Having a paid job or engaging in work for a living
entries.to_definition: Ko hono ma‘u ha ngāue totongi pe fakahoko ha ngāue ke ma‘u ai ha mo‘ui .

entries.en_definition: Working a standard number of hours weekly (e.g., 35-40 hours), usually with full benefits.
entries.to_definition: Ngaue 'i ha houa angamaheni 'i he uike (e.g., houa 'e 35-40), 'oku angamaheni 'aki 'a hono maú ó e kotoa ó e ngaahi mouía fakangaue.

entries.en_definition: Working fewer hours than full-time, often with more flexibility and potentially fewer benefits.
entries.to_definition: Ngāue  pe 'i ha houa siʻisiʻi ange ʻi he taimi ngaue  kakató, feliuliuaki e taimi ngaue', pea siísií ange e ngaahi monuía fakangaue'.

entries.en_definition: Work limited to a specific period, task, or project, not ongoing
entries.to_definition: Ngāue fakangatangata ki ha vahaʻataimi pau, ngāue, pe poloseki, ʻo ʻikai hokohoko atu .

entries.en_definition: The number of people actively looking for a job who can't find one.
entries.to_definition: Ko e tokolahi ʻo e kakai ʻoku nau kumi ngāue tatuólahi ka ókuʻikai lava ke  maʻu ha ngāue.

entries.en_definition: Job loss due to predictable, recurring changes in demand for labor at certain times of the year.
entries.to_definition: Mole á e ngaue', makatuúnga he feliuliuaki e fahaí taú'moe tukunga.

entries.en_definition: Short-term unemployment as people are between jobs, searching for their first job, or re-entering the workforce.
entries.to_definition: Ta'ema'ungāue taimi nounou makatuúnga 'i he feliuliuaki/fehikitaki ki ha ngāue kehe, kumi ngāue foóu pe ko e hū foóu ki ha ngāueánga.

entries.en_definition: Mismatch between workers' skills and available jobs.
entries.to_definition: Ta'ema'ungāue makatuúnga 'i he íkai fenāpasi á e taukei fakangāue' moe ngāue óku átā.

entries.en_definition: Unemployment caused by overall economic downturns or recessions.
entries.to_definition: Ta'ema'ungāue 'i he tōlalo fakalukufua ai 'a e 'Ékonōmika'.

entries.en_definition: Government decisions about spending and taxation.
entries.to_definition: Tuútuúni Ngaue Kai.

entries.en_definition: Central bank actions affecting money supply and interest rates.
entries.to_definition: Tuútuúni Ngaue Fakapaánga.

entries.en_definition: The cost of borrowing or reward for saving money.
entries.to_definition: Fakamole ó no paánga', pe koe pale hono haofaki ó e silini'.

entries.en_definition: Value of one currency compared to another.
entries.to_definition: Mahuínga hono fakafetongi e paánga'.

entries.en_definition: Record of all economic transactions between a country and the rest of the world.
entries.to_definition: Lekooti ‘o e ngaahi fefakatau’aki faka’ekonomika kotoa pe ‘i he vaha’a ‘o ha fonua mo e toenga ‘o mamani.

entries.en_definition: Exports exceed imports.
entries.to_definition: ‘Oku lahi ange ‘a e koloa ‘oku ‘ave ki tu’apule’anga ‘i he koloa hū mai.

entries.en_definition: Imports exceed exports.
entries.to_definition: ‘Oku lahi ange ‘a e koloa hū mai ‘i he koloa hū atu ki muli.

entries.to_term: totongi ngaue pau mei he Puleánga.
entries.en_definition: A government payment to encourage or support certain activities.
entries.to_definition: Ko ha totongi ‘a e pule‘angá ke fakalototo‘a‘i pe poupou‘i ha ngaahi ngāue tuúpau.

entries.en_definition: Government collection of revenue from individuals and businesses.
entries.to_definition: Ko e tanaki pa'anga 'a e pule'anga mei he kakai fakafo'ituitui mo e ngaahi pisinisi.

entries.en_definition: Tax rate increases as income increases.
entries.to_definition: ‘Oku holo ‘a e totongi tukuhau ‘i he holo ‘a e pa’anga hū mai.

entries.en_definition: Tax rate decreases as income increases.
entries.to_definition: ‘Oku holo hifo ‘a e totongi tukuhaú ‘i he tupulaki ‘a e pa‘anga hū maí.

entries.en_definition: The supply and demand for labour.
entries.to_definition: Ko e tu’uaki mo e fiema’u ki he ngaue.

entries.en_definition: The lowest legal wage that can be paid to workers.
entries.to_definition: Ko e totongi fakalao ma'ulalo taha 'e lava ke totongi ki he kau ngaue.

entries.en_definition: Output per unit of input.
entries.to_definition: Output ki he 'iuniti 'o e input.

entries.en_definition: Focusing on a narrow range of products or tasks.
entries.to_definition: Tokangataha ki ha ngaahi koloa pe ngaahi ngaue 'oku fakangatangata.

entries.en_definition: Ability to produce a good at lower opportunity cost than another producer.
entries.to_definition: Malava ke ngaohi ha koloa 'i he totongi faingamalie ma'ulalo ange 'i ha taha kehe 'oku ne ngaohi.

entries.en_definition: The removal of barriers to trade.
entries.to_definition: Ko hono to’o ‘o e ngaahi fakafe’ātungia ki he fefakatau’aki.

entries.en_definition: Policies that protect domestic industries from foreign competition.
entries.to_definition: Ngaahi tu’utu’uni ‘oku ne malu’i ‘a e ngaahi ngaue’anga fakalotofonua mei he fe’auhi mei muli.

entries.en_definition: A limit on the quantity of imports.
entries.to_definition: Ko ha fakangatangata ki he lahi ‘o e ngaahi koloa hū mai.

entries.en_definition: A tax on imported goods.
entries.to_definition: Ko ha tukuhau ki he koloa hū mai.

entries.en_definition: A market with one seller and no competition.
entries.to_definition: Ko ha maketi 'oku taha pe 'a e tokotaha fakatau pea 'ikai ha fe'auhi.

entries.en_definition: A market dominated by just two firms, whose actions heavily influence each other.
entries.to_definition: Ko ha māketi ‘oku pule‘i ‘e ha ongo kautaha pē ‘e ua, ‘a ia ‘oku fetākiekina lahi ‘ena ngaahi ngāué.

entries.en_definition: A market dominated by a few large firms.
entries.to_definition: Ko ha maketi 'oku pule'i 'e ha ngaahi kautaha lalahi tokosi'i.

entries.en_definition: Many firms selling differentiated but similar products, allowing slight price control with relatively easy entry.
entries.to_definition: Oku lahi 'a e ngaahi kautaha 'oku nau fakatau atu 'a e ngaahi koloa kehekehe ka 'oku tatau, 'o faka'ata 'a e ki'i pule'i 'o e totongi 'aki 'a e hū 'oku faingofua 'aupito.

entries.en_definition: A market with many buyers and sellers, and no barriers to entry.
entries.to_definition: Ko ha māketi ‘oku tokolahi ai ‘a e kau fakataú mo e kau fakataú, pea ‘ikai ha ngaahi fakafaingata‘a‘ia‘anga ki he hū ki aí.

entries.to_term: Ánalaiso fakafehoanaki  e kovi moe lelei
entries.en_definition: Weighing the costs and benefits of a decision.
entries.to_definition: Ko hono fua ‘a e ngaahi fakamole mo e ngaahi ‘aonga ‘o ha tu‘utu‘uni.

entries.en_definition: The cost of producing one more unit.
entries.to_definition: Ko e fakamole ki hono ngaohi ha toe ʻiuniti ʻe taha.

entries.en_definition: The revenue gained from selling one more unit.
entries.to_definition: Ko e paʻanga naʻe maʻu mei hono fakatau atu ha toe ʻiuniti ʻe taha.

entries.en_definition: Satisfaction or benefit derived from consuming a good or service.
entries.to_definition: Ko e fiemālie pe lelei ‘oku ma‘u mei hono fakamoleki ha koloa pe ngāue.

entries.en_definition: A financial plan showing income and expenses.
entries.to_definition: Ko ha palani fakapaʻanga ʻoku fakahaaʻi ai ʻa e paʻanga hū maí mo e fakamolé.

entries.en_definition: Spending on capital goods to generate future returns.
entries.to_definition: Fakamole ki he ngaahi koloa fakalukufua ke fakatupu ha pa'anga 'i he kaha'u.

entries.en_definition: A mathematical relationship showing the maximum output that can be produced from a given set of inputs.
A time period in which at least one factor of production is fixed, typically capital.
A time period in which all factors of production are variable and can be adjusted.
The total quantity of output produced by a firm with a given amount of inputs.
The additional output generated by adding one more unit of a variable input (e.g., labor).
A principle stating that as more of a variable input is added to a fixed input, the marginal product will eventually decrease.
How a firm's output changes in the long run when all inputs are increased proportionally.
The sum of all costs, including both fixed and variable costs, for a given level of production.
Costs that do not change with the level of output in the short run (e.g., rent).
Costs that change directly with the level of output (e.g., raw materials, wages).
The change in total cost resulting from producing one more unit of output.
Total cost per unit of output, calculated as TC/Q.
Fixed cost per unit of output, calculated as FC/Q.
Variable cost per unit of output, calculated as VC/Q.
The reduction in average cost per unit as a firm increases its scale of production in the long run.
The increase in average cost per unit that can occur as a firm's scale of production becomes too large.
Producing the maximum possible output from a given set of inputs.
Producing a given level of output at the lowest possible cost.
A line on a graph showing all combinations of inputs that can be purchased for a given total cost.
A curve on a graph showing all combinations of two inputs that yield the same level of output.
